title: Handles Become Too Hot -- You'll Need Pot Holders
text: Handles Become Too Hot -- You'll Need Pot Holders. This pan should have been made with silicone wrapped around the handles, or whatever material they could have used to keep the handles from getting hot. They used metal handles, and they heat up fast. If you buy this pan, you will need to use pot holders.
